description: This file defines the interface 'ThingsSearchPersistence' which specifies methods for persisting and retrieving search-related data in a thing search service. It includes methods for initializing indices, generating reports, counting documents, finding documents by query, streaming metadata, and other persistence operations related to 'things'.

classes.name: ThingsSearchPersistence
classes.description: Interface defining persistence operations for the search service, including index initialization, reporting, counting, finding, and streaming search data.

methods.name: initializeIndices
methods.description: Initializes the search index asynchronously, setting up necessary structures for search operations.

methods.name: generateNamespaceCountReport
methods.description: Creates a report of the count of things per namespace, returning a reactive stream.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns a source emitting the count of documents matching a query with authorization filtering.

methods.name: sudoCount
methods.description: Returns a source emitting the total count of documents matching a query, regardless of visibility.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Finds all documents matching a query with optional namespace filtering, returning a source of result lists.

methods.name: findAllUnlimited
methods.description: Streams all matching document IDs without size limits, with optional namespace filtering.

methods.name: sudoStreamMetadata
methods.description: Streams metadata entries of all search index entries not marked for deletion, starting from a given lower bound.
